dataset.random_pairs: all cross-family enrolment pairs within each evaluated split
dataset.test_policy: 12 pilot test families remain unevaluated and may not affect models, thresholds, weights, or decisions

representations.image_baseline_policy: carry P5 SigLIP smoke evidence as context only; P7 owns pilot image execution

threshold_selection.candidate_rule: all unique training scores plus the next representable value above the maximum
threshold_selection.objective: lexicographically minimise maximum(FRR, near-FAR, random-FAR), total error, accepted-negative mass; then prefer the strictest threshold

viability.intended_use: technical second-factor candidate; not standalone authentication evidence
viability.gate_rule: all bounds must pass for the frozen primary matcher; oracle diagnostics and exploratory baselines cannot pass Gate A

uncertainty.zero_event_guard: upper bound is at least 3 divided by independent validation families
uncertainty.multiplicity: primary matcher only; baseline/subgroup intervals exploratory with no confirmatory claims

acceptance_region.finite_dictionary: within-split enrolment concepts plus each target's one-atom neighbour
acceptance_region.boundary: controlled/provisional probability mass only; no claim about human secret choice or population guessing
